model.name: Tuned LightGBM (DART boosting), Platt-calibrated
model.features: CUF fields + trajectory + peer/agency-historical context (34 features)
model.target: Schedule deterioration OR cost escalation within 3 months (target_at_risk_3m)
model.target_note: Deliberately excludes progress-stall alone from the composite - stall is common/noisy and was found to inflate apparent risk without adding decision-relevant signal.
model.cost_overrun_ci: PR-AUC 95% CI [0.51, 0.83], n=31 events - wide, disclosed rather than hidden

audit.source_coverage: 13 monthly MoSPI Flash Reports used in the locked model: June 2025 - June 2026
audit.source_note: A July 2026 report was later located and is NOT yet integrated into the locked model - disclosed as a known extension, not silently added.
audit.performance_monitoring_note: A separate 'Performance Monitoring' publication (sector-level monthly target/achievement) was found on the PAIMANA site during this research. It was not part of the SIH-linked dataset and has NOT been merged into this model - flagged here as a documented, unexplored future signal, not used in any current number.
audit.entity_resolution: 1,152-row exact crosswalk (Legacy OCMS Code -> PAIMANA Project Code); 72.1% of June 2025 OCMS project codes resolved to a canonical ID
audit.dq_flags: 260 / 18,033 rows (1.44%) flagged for source-data pathology (bad duration, extreme schedule slip, implausible cost utilization) - excluded from training, not deleted from the panel
audit.morth_gap: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways absent from source reports Jul-Nov 2025; primary model horizon (3-month) chosen specifically to restore Roads representation - verified Roads ROC-AUC 0.840 vs non-Roads 0.841
audit.leakage_audit: 7 real bugs found and fixed across two rounds of independent audit (calendar-vs-row-position errors in target construction and 4 trajectory features; same-month cross-project leakage in agency-history and category-capping features). Every fix measured; largest single movement was 0.017 ROC-AUC, most were near zero.
audit.cross_pipeline_check: A parallel feature-engineering pipeline (built independently) was run against this project's own verified panel data and compared fairly on identical target/split/model. Result: statistically indistinguishable (bootstrap 95% CI on the PR-AUC delta included zero) - no feature set proven superior.
audit.status: PASS WITH LIMITATIONS - not claimed 100% accurate; every known limitation above is disclosed, not hidden.
